capabilities: Upload local images from a note to a configured storage service
Rewrite image links to public URLs and copy the exported Markdown to the clipboard
Batch-process multiple images with progress feedback
Convert Mermaid code blocks to PNG images before upload
Download and re-upload web images to prevent link rot
extras: Desktop platforms only; mobile is not supported. Users must self-register an Imgur Client ID since the plugin no longer bundles a shared one. Documentation elsewhere for detailed storage setup; no telemetry.
intentEvidence: builds upon the work of several exceptional projects
problem: Publishing notes to static sites requires images to be externally hosted, but Obsidian keeps them as local attachments with links that break outside the vault.

relations.evidence: Reference implementation for Imgur upload functionality
This plugin was inspired by the powerful markdown editor MWeb Pro

requires.name: storage service API key or token (e.g. Imgur Client ID, GitHub token)
account with a supported storage service

summary: Image upload toolkit that sends local images embedded in a note to a cloud storage service and copies Markdown with public URLs for publishing.
